name: The Crescendo
description: The Crescendo is a Cabaretti celebration in New Capenna that the Adversary's loyalists planned to infiltrate.

summary.text: The Crescendo is a Cabaretti celebration in New Capenna that the Adversary's loyalists planned to infiltrate.

bio.text: Vivien overheard Navy, a double agent, arranging with a Maestro for the Crescendo.
Vivien resolved to be at the Crescendo, where Elspeth would likely be, and learned from Urabrask that the Adversary is a demon planeswalker.

status.text: The last events in the material show Vivien planning to attend the Crescendo; other pages describe it as the party where the Adversary's infiltrators struck every family.

timeline.summary: Vivien spots Navy slipping out the back and overhears her as a double agent arranging with a Maestro for the Crescendo.
Vivien resolves to be at the Crescendo where Elspeth will likely be, and learns from Urabrask that the Adversary is a demon planeswalker.
timeline.quote: "Tezzeret mentioned he is a planeswalker, too."

pages_say.description: A great Cabaretti celebration being prepared.
A Cabaretti celebration the Adversary intends to turn into a takeover.
An upcoming gathering in New Capenna that Maestros loyal to the Adversary plan to infiltrate and that Vivien expects to start the end of the city as it was.
The yearly gathering of the families, held at the Vantoleone, where the Cabaretti unveil the Font and the Adversary launches his attack.
The party at which the Adversary's infiltrators struck every family.
